official_sources.finding: The Basic POST /jobs body declares an explicit validate_only boolean defaulting to false. RTC_GAMMA lists exactly the candidate option keys and defaults; the proposed four jobs explicitly set all options. The jobs_response schema has jobs required and validate_only optional.

The public post_jobs handler validates job definitions and passes dry_run=bool(body.get('validate_only')) to dynamo.jobs.put_jobs. This is repository source behavior, not a verified live response from the Basic deployment.

The public put_jobs implementation prepares cost and enforces application status and credit sufficiency, but credit decrement and DynamoDB job writes occur only when dry_run is false. A validate-only response may still contain a generated job_id and PENDING status despite no job write; these fields alone must not be interpreted as submission.

interpretation.inference: A Basic request with validate_only true appears designed to evaluate exact-scene eligibility and quoted cost without consuming credits or persisting a job, if the deployed service follows this reviewed public source.

control_implications: Require explicit validate_only true in each one-job request; the API default is false.
Treat the live response and no-credit/no-persistent-job properties as unverified until observed under a separate secret-safe source and execution gate.

Require owner-account capacity and application-status evidence, exact frozen source/order/option bytes, a sanitized receipt, and stop on an ambiguous response. Do not infer product or pixel rights from validation.
released_action: None. This public-source observation authorizes no authenticated POST, job submission, credit use, product acquisition, pixel read, or map claim.
